hooks.name: Static analysis on save
hooks.description: Report-only: runs ESLint across src and quality/hooks/desktop/mcp/harness scripts, circular import check, layer boundary check, and size limits when source or quality/harness scripts are saved.

action.command: npm run quality:lint && node scripts/quality/check-cycles.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-layers.mjs && node scripts/quality/check-size.mjs src scripts/desktop
